title: Vetro Power Sofa Nano Coating Spray (Fabric & Upholstery Protector) - 100 ml
description: Fabric protector spray for sofa, couch and upholstery Vetro Power Fabric & Upholstery Protector is a nano coating spray that forms an invisible, hydrophobic layer on fabric. Water, oil and other liquids bead on the surface instead of soaking into the fibres, so spills can be wiped away before they stain. It keeps the original texture, colour and breathability of your upholstery and dries without residue. Water-based and PFAS-free: our Fabric Protector is made with just two ingredients, silicon dioxide (SiO2) and deionised water. Made in Mumbai by Vetro Power, nanocoating specialists since 2015 – our coatings protect upholstery at NMACC, Taj, Hyatt and Four Seasons. Use it on Sofas and couches Dining chairs, accent chairs and recliners Cushions and headboards Other upholstered furniture For carpets and rugs, use our Carpet & Rug Protector Spray. For car seats and mats, use our Car Fabric & Carpet Protector Spray. Why choose Vetro Power fabric protector Repels water and oil-based spills Invisible – no change to colour, texture or feel Breathable, with no residue Quick-drying, easy to apply PFAS-free, water-based formula Long-lasting – 18–24 months from one application How to apply fabric protector spray Make sure the fabric is clean and dry – vacuum first. Test a small hidden spot. Shake the bottle well. Spray from about 15 cm away, ensuring an even coat. Buff with a soft brush. Repeat after 10 minutes and let it dry. To check coverage, sprinkle a few drops of water once dry – they should bead on the surface. If they soak in, apply another light coat to that area. Sizes 100 ml, 250 ml and 1 litre for home use; 5, 20, 25 and 200 litre for professional applicators. Prefer us to do it?
